rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good blastocyst and acknowledges possible contour irregularity, but it somewhat overstates ICM/TE clarity from this single image and describes the blastocoel as occupying most of the embryo despite visible partial collapse/irregular cavity.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, tubal factor, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, prior cycle history, and partner age with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy over morphology, though the implantation estimate is somewhat broad and morphology interpretation is slightly more confident than the image alone supports.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF practice, including SET preference and individualized PGT-A discussion; minor limitation is some speculative emphasis on hydrosalpinx without confirmation.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management, lifestyle, luteal support, hydrosalpinx review, and future-cycle planning including trigger/maturity review and timing considerations.
